evidence: The Zn1/C0xSnxOy buffer layers are grown using a Microchemistry F-120 ALD reactor with a proven process with diethyl zinc (DEZn or Zn(C2H5)2) as zinc precursor, tetrakis(dimethylamino) tin (TDMASn or Sn(N(CH3)2)4) as tin precursor, de-ionized water (H2O) as oxygen precursor and nitrogen (N2) as carrier and purge gas.
